description: Four supplied-price methods: electricity measured kWh or input power/hours/count/load, and natural gas, propane or heating oil from measured fuel or useful heat/efficiency. Fetch dated EIA references separately; no price is fetched by math. Explicit units, inactive fields zero, period costs and price scenarios. Returns an unsigned replayable receipt. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

comparison.description: Comparison price (USD/kWh). A separate user-entered price scenario, not a forecast.

count.description: Number of identical machines. Use a positive whole count for power entry.

hours.description: Operating hours per machine in this period.

load.description: Average fraction of rated input used (%). For power entry only; 100 means full stated input throughout.

other.description: Other costs in the SAME period (USD). Only costs excluded from the entered price. An EIA average can already reflect bill components; adding them again can double count.

power.description: Electrical INPUT power per machine (kW). Use metered input power, not useful output rating. Set to zero for measured entry.

price.description: Applied or entered price (USD/kWh). Enter the matching rate from your bill, supplier quote or dated EIA reference. A reported average is not a tariff.

quantity.description: Measured electricity use for this period (kWh). Used only with measured entry; set to zero for power entry.

content.description: Fuel heat content (Btu/Mcf). Confirm against your supplier/bill. EIA conversion examples are approximate; composition and reporting year can differ.

efficiency.description: Delivered-heat efficiency (%). Must exceed zero; this is fuel combustion efficiency, not heat-pump COP.

heat.description: Required USEFUL heat delivered (kWh thermal). Set to zero with measured entry. This is heat delivered, not electrical consumption.
